title: Massachusetts Income
text:
library(tidycensus)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)

census_api_key("f75eb76377f5f57e17f4d63e4912b48282db59c9", overwrite = TRUE)

ma_income <- get_acs(
  geography = "tract",
  variables = "B19013_001",  # Median household income
  state = "MA",
  year = 2022,
  geometry = TRUE,
  progress = FALSE           # suppress progress bar
)


# Now plot the data
ggplot(ma_income) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "Median Income ($)") +
  labs(
    title = "Massachusetts Median Household Income by Census Tract",
    caption = "Source: ACS 5-Year Estimates (2022)"
  ) +
  theme_void()
